data.name: Farm To Defend
data.detailed_description:
Tower Defense:

FarmToDefend is a game where you must defend the Yokis (an hourglass) against hordes of enemies.
To do so, you have access to weapons and a whole arsenal of defenses and tools.
Defenses cost resources to place and upgrade.
There are 12 maps to conquer, each lasting up to wave 50.

Production:

Production resources can be obtained in various ways, including through resource-producing buildings.
These buildings regularly generate resources, allowing you to place defenses and tools.
They require exploration resources to be constructed and upgraded.

Exploration:

Exploration resources can be found in several ways, such as exploring the surroundings or defeating creatures.
While exploring, you’ll also find weapon chests that will help you strengthen your defenses.

Progression:

At the end of each game, you’ll earn permanent bonuses for future runs.
During a run, you can also buy temporary bonuses in exchange for a certain amount of exploration resources.
The further you progress in the game, the more permanent bonuses you’ll unlock to help you advance more easily.

Platform:

As you progress, you’ll unlock trials that grant new skills for your hero.
These trials will test your agility and mastery of your abilities.
But that’s not all — you’ll also unlock challenges that will put your skills to the test through various missions.

So, what are you waiting for? Embark on the adventure!
